name: quota-band
description: Account, quota, context and cache cards above the Claude Code prompt, with handoffs and a warning before a turn rewrites the prompt cache; quota and routing come from CLIProxyAPI with the quota-pilot plugin

handoffAt.title: Suggest a handoff at (% of context)
handoffAt.description: How full the context is, in percent, when the band suggests handing off to a new session that starts from a summary. 0 never suggests it; /handoff works either way.

holdColdDefault.title: Hold a message before a cold turn
holdColdDefault.description: Whether a new session holds a message that would start a cold turn (the prompt cache expired, or the session moved to another account, provider or model), with what it costs, until you confirm it. /hold-cold on or off changes one session.

confirmColdAbove.title: Hold above (tokens)
confirmColdAbove.description: Conversation size from which a message into a cold turn is held, while holding is on, and from which a switch while the cache is warm says what it costs first. 0: any size.

keepWarmDefault.title: Keep the cache warm while away
keepWarmDefault.description: Whether a new session keeps the prompt cache warm while you are away, each time shortly before it would expire, at about a tenth of the input price. /keep-warm on or off changes one session.

keepWarm.title: Keep warm up to (times)
keepWarm.description: How many times the cache is kept warm each time you are away, while keeping warm is on: 1 to 10.
